game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ember furnace.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ember furnace. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ember furnace using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the ember furnace is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 12.
